answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 5 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. The wander multiplier is published, charged in ivory, and vine lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 4295 identities would post 2960 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
